candidates.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing
candidates.reason: MoE serving system addressing dynamic expert load imbalance through layer-aware load prediction plus elastic serverless expert scaling/placement. Prototype and real-workload evaluation report latency and cost reductions.

candidates.title: HybriMoE: Hybrid CPU-GPU Scheduling and Cache Management for Efficient MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Implemented kTransformers-based MoE inference framework combining dynamic CPU-GPU intra-layer scheduling, inter-layer prefetch, and score-based expert caching, with measured prefill/decode speedups.

rejected_candidates.title: Mixture-of-Experts Serving
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Primarily a theoretical online/offline algorithmic model with competitive-ratio and hardness results rather than an implemented LLM inference system with systems evaluation; lower fit for the repository's inference-system survey.
